aboutWaqf.title: What is a Family Waqf?
aboutWaqf.description: A family waqf is the dedication of property or financial assets for the benefit of the founder during their lifetime, and then to their descendants. It is considered one of the noblest forms of kindness to family and preserving family heritage.

whatIsWaqf.title: What is a Family Waqf?
whatIsWaqf.description: A family waqf is the dedication of a financial or real estate asset for the founder to benefit from during their lifetime, then the benefit of this asset passes to their descendants. It is one of the most important Sharia-compliant forms of preserving family wealth and ensuring its continuity across generations.

purpose.title: Purpose of This Waqf
purpose.description: The Khadawardi Waqf aims to preserve and grow family assets, and ensure that family members benefit from their returns in a fair and sustainable manner. The waqf also seeks to strengthen kinship ties and reinforce bonds between family members.

currentGeneration.title: Current Generation of Beneficiaries
currentGeneration.description: The current generation of beneficiaries consists of grandchildren and children from the eighth and ninth generations, numbering approximately 200 individuals spread across various regions of the Kingdom and the world.

stewardship.title: Stewardship
stewardship.description: Preserving assets and maintaining them for the benefit of future generations

fairness.title: Fairness
fairness.description: Distributing returns fairly and equally among all beneficiaries

unity.title: Unity
unity.description: Strengthening kinship ties and communication between family members

gated.title: Distribution Details
gated.description: Annual returns are distributed based on a points system that takes into account the number of individuals in each family and their special needs. The General Assembly meeting is held annually to review performance and approve the budget.

variationA.label: Variation A — Editorial Long-form
variationA.intro: The concept of family waqf represents one of the most enduring forms of Islamic philanthropy, bridging personal devotion with collective benefit. In its essence, a waqf is not merely a legal arrangement but a covenant across time.
variationA.definition: A family waqf dedicates assets for the benefit of the founder during their lifetime, then passes to descendants in perpetuity. This creates an unbroken chain of stewardship that spans generations.
variationA.legacy: The Khadawardi Waqf embodies this tradition, established with foresight and maintained with care through nearly a century of change.

variationB.label: Variation B — Definition Cards
variationB.definitionText: A legal dedication of assets for familial benefit across generations
variationB.purposeText: Preserve wealth, strengthen bonds, ensure continuity
variationB.scopeText: Real estate and financial assets under unified management
variationB.durationText: Perpetual — from founder through all descendants

variationC.label: Variation C — Q&A Format
variationC.q1: What makes a waqf different from inheritance?
variationC.a1: Unlike inheritance, which divides assets at death, a waqf preserves the core assets intact while distributing only their returns. The principal remains protected for future generations.
variationC.q2: Who can benefit from the waqf?
variationC.a2: All descendants of the founders, in perpetuity. The waqf creates an expanding circle of beneficiaries that grows with each generation.
variationC.a3: Through the General Assembly of beneficiaries, with oversight from appointed administrators who ensure compliance with the original deed and Sharia principles.

founders.title: The Founders
founders.subtitle: Fathers who founded this waqf with foresight for the future

founder1.name: Sheikh Abdulrahman Al-Khadawardi
founder1.bio: A prominent businessman and merchant who established this waqf at the beginning of the unified Kingdom. He was known for his wisdom and foresight.

founder2.name: Sheikh Mohammed Al-Khadawardi
founder2.bio: Co-founder and support to his brother in building this family institution. He was known for his generosity and love of good deeds.

founder3.name: Sheikha Fatima Al-Khadawardiyah
founder3.bio: The backbone of the family, she supported the waqf with dedication and worked on raising generations with values of kindness and benevolence.

gated.title: Memories and Stories

variationA.label: Variation A — Editorial Portrait + Biography
variationA.extendedBio1: Sheikh Abdulrahman was a visionary merchant who foresaw the importance of preserving family wealth through Islamic endowment. His business acumen and spiritual devotion guided the establishment of this lasting institution.
variationA.extendedBio2: Sheikh Mohammed complemented his brother's vision with practical wisdom and a generous spirit. He ensured the waqf remained accessible and beneficial to all family members regardless of circumstance.
variationA.extendedBio3: Sheikha Fatima brought strength and compassion to the family. Her dedication to education and moral upbringing shaped generations who continue to honor the waqf's principles.
